mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase primaquine metabolism complications; primaquine carries hemolytic risk in G6PD deficiency while duloxetine increases serotonin levels, both contributing to adverse effects.
action: Ensure G6PD screening before primaquine use; monitor for hemolytic anemia signs, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and CNS effects; consider alternative antimalarial if high risk.
